def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

inductive ProposalRun (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :
    ProposalState Man Woman → List Man → ProposalState Man Woman → Prop
  | nil (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : ProposalRun prefW state [] state
  | cons {state mid final : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {schedule : List Man} :
      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →
          ProposalRun prefW state (m :: schedule) final

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

def WomanRejectsManAt (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (w : Woman) (rejected : Man) : Prop :=
  ∃ kept : Man, state.matching.held w = some kept ∧ prefW.pref w kept rejected

theorem chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) old := by
  unfold WeaklyPrefers chooseBetterForW
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
    prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

theorem chooseBetterForW_preserves_pref_below_old
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman)
    (incoming old rejected : Man)
    (hOld : prefW.pref w old rejected) :
    prefW.pref w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) rejected := by
  rcases chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old prefW w incoming old with hEq | hBetter
  · simpa [hEq] using hOld
  · exact prefW.trans w hBetter hOld

theorem WomanRejectsManAt_preserved_step
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state next : ProposalState Man Woman} {activated : Man}
    {w : Woman} {rejected : Man}
    (hStep : ProposalStepRel prefW state activated next)
    (hReject : WomanRejectsManAt prefW state w rejected) :
    WomanRejectsManAt prefW next w rejected := by
  rcases hReject with ⟨kept, hHeld, hPref⟩
  rcases hStep with hInactive | hRest
  · rcases hInactive with ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨kept, hHeld, hPref⟩
  rcases hRest with hExhausted | hProposal
  · rcases hExhausted with ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨kept, hHeld, hPref⟩
  rcases hProposal with
    ⟨target, tail, _hFree, _hRem, hTarget, hOther, _hNextRem, _hRemOther⟩
  by_cases hSame : w = target
  · subst target
    rcases hTarget with hEmpty | hOld
    · rcases hEmpty with ⟨hWasEmpty, _hNextHeld⟩
      rw [hHeld] at hWasEmpty
      cases hWasEmpty
    · rcases hOld with ⟨old, hOldHeld, hNextHeld⟩
      have hOldEq : old = kept := by
        rw [hHeld] at hOldHeld
        exact (Option.some.inj hOldHeld).symm
      refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW w activated old, hNextHeld, ?_⟩
      apply chooseBetterForW_preserves_pref_below_old
      simpa [hOldEq] using hPref
  · exact ⟨kept, by rw [hOther w hSame, hHeld], hPref⟩

theorem WomanRejectsManAt_preserved_run
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    {state final : ProposalState Man Woman} {schedule : List Man}
    {w : Woman} {rejected : Man}
    (hRun : ProposalRun prefW state schedule final)
    (hReject : WomanRejectsManAt prefW state w rejected) :
    WomanRejectsManAt prefW final w rejected := by
  induction hRun with
  | nil state =>
      exact hReject
  | cons hStep hRun ih =>
      exact ih (WomanRejectsManAt_preserved_step prefW hStep hReject)

theorem noDuplicateHolds_of_proposalRun :
    ∀ {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
    ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state →
      NoDuplicateHolds state.matching := by
  intro Man Woman prefW fullList schedule state hReach
  classical
  have step_preserves :
      ∀ {state next : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man},
        ProposalStepRel prefW state m next →
          NoDuplicateHolds state.matching → NoDuplicateHolds next.matching := by
    intro state next m hStep hNoDup
    intro w₁ w₂ heldMan h₁ h₂
    rcases hStep with ⟨_, hnext⟩ | ⟨_, _, hnext⟩ | hproposal
    · subst next
      exact hNoDup h₁ h₂
    · subst next
      exact hNoDup h₁ h₂
    · rcases hproposal with
        ⟨w, tail, hFree, hrem, hchange, hsame, hnextRem, hotherRem⟩
      by_cases hw₁ : w₁ = w
      · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
        · exact hw₁.trans hw₂.symm
        · subst w₁
          rcases hchange with hempty | hheld
          · rcases hempty with ⟨hwasEmpty, hnextw⟩
            have hheld_eq : heldMan = m := by
              exact (Option.some.inj (hnextw.symm.trans h₁)).symm
            have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
              simpa [hsame w₂ hw₂] using h₂
            exact False.elim (hFree w₂ (by simpa [hheld_eq] using hstate₂))
          · rcases hheld with ⟨old, hwasOld, hnextw⟩
            have hheld_eq : heldMan = chooseBetterForW prefW w m old := by
              exact (Option.some.inj (hnextw.symm.trans h₁)).symm
            have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
              simpa [hsame w₂ hw₂] using h₂
            have hchoice :
                chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = m ∨
                  chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = old := by
              unfold chooseBetterForW
              by_cases hp : prefW.pref w m old
              · simp [hp]
              · simp [hp]
            rcases hchoice with hchosen | hchosen
            · exact False.elim (hFree w₂ (by simpa [hheld_eq, hchosen] using hstate₂))
            · have hstate₂_old : state.matching.held w₂ = some old := by
                simpa [hheld_eq, hchosen] using hstate₂
              have hw_eq : w = w₂ := hNoDup hwasOld hstate₂_old
              exact False.elim (hw₂ hw_eq.symm)
      · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
        · subst w₂
          rcases hchange with hempty | hheld
          · rcases hempty with ⟨hwasEmpty, hnextw⟩
            have hheld_eq : heldMan = m := by
              exact (Option.some.inj (hnextw.symm.trans h₂)).symm
            have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
              simpa [hsame w₁ hw₁] using h₁
            exact False.elim (hFree w₁ (by simpa [hheld_eq] using hstate₁))
          · rcases hheld with ⟨old, hwasOld, hnextw⟩
            have hheld_eq : heldMan = chooseBetterForW prefW w m old := by
              exact (Option.some.inj (hnextw.symm.trans h₂)).symm
            have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
              simpa [hsame w₁ hw₁] using h₁
            have hchoice :
                chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = m ∨
                  chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = old := by
              unfold chooseBetterForW
              by_cases hp : prefW.pref w m old
              · simp [hp]
              · simp [hp]
            rcases hchoice with hchosen | hchosen
            · exact False.elim (hFree w₁ (by simpa [hheld_eq, hchosen] using hstate₁))
            · have hstate₁_old : state.matching.held w₁ = some old := by
                simpa [hheld_eq, hchosen] using hstate₁
              have hw_eq : w₁ = w := hNoDup hstate₁_old hwasOld
              exact False.elim (hw₁ hw_eq)
        · have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
            simpa [hsame w₁ hw₁] using h₁
          have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
            simpa [hsame w₂ hw₂] using h₂
          exact hNoDup hstate₁ hstate₂
  have run_preserves :
      ∀ {initial final : ProposalState Man Woman} {schedule : List Man},
        ProposalRun prefW initial schedule final →
          NoDuplicateHolds initial.matching → NoDuplicateHolds final.matching := by
    intro initial final schedule hRun
    induction hRun with
    | nil state =>
        intro hNoDup
        exact hNoDup
    | cons hStep hTail ih =>
        intro hNoDup
        exact ih (step_preserves hStep hNoDup)
  apply run_preserves hReach
  intro w₁ w₂ m h₁ h₂
  simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at h₁

theorem man_prefers_current_not_held_self
    {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v} [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman)
    (hNoDup : NoDuplicateHolds state.matching) :
    ∀ {m w},
      ManPrefersCurrent prefM state.matching m w →
        state.matching.held w ≠ some m := by
  intro m w hPref hHeld
  have hPartner : partnerOfMan state.matching m = some w := by
    unfold partnerOfMan
    classical
    have hExists : ∃ w' : Woman, state.matching.held w' = some m := ⟨w, hHeld⟩
    have hChoose : state.matching.held (Classical.choose hExists) = some m :=
      Classical.choose_spec hExists
    have hChooseEq : Classical.choose hExists = w := hNoDup hChoose hHeld
    simp [hExists, hChooseEq]
  unfold ManPrefersCurrent at hPref
  rw [hPartner] at hPref
  exact prefM.irrefl m w hPref

theorem man_prefers_current_not_remaining
    {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v} [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman)
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hReach : ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state)
    (hQuiet : Quiescent state) :
    ∀ {m w},
      ManPrefersCurrent prefM state.matching m w →
        w ∉ state.rem m := by
  intro m w hPref
  classical
  have step_preserves :
      ∀ {s n : ProposalState Man Woman} {proposer : Man},
        ProposalStepRel prefW s proposer n →
          (∀ x : Man, ∃ proposed : List Woman,
            fullList x = proposed ++ s.rem x ∧
              ∀ y : Woman, s.matching.held y = some x → y ∈ proposed) →
            ∀ x : Man, ∃ proposed : List Woman,
              fullList x = proposed ++ n.rem x ∧
                ∀ y : Woman, n.matching.held y = some x → y ∈ proposed := by
    intro s n proposer hStep hInv x
    rcases hStep with hInactive | hActive
    · rcases hInactive with ⟨_, hEq⟩
      subst n
      exact hInv x
    · rcases hActive with hEmpty | hProposal
      · rcases hEmpty with ⟨_, _, hEq⟩
        subst n
        exact hInv x
      · rcases hProposal with
          ⟨w0, tail, hFree, hRem, hChange, hOtherHeld, hNextRem, hOtherRem⟩
        rcases hInv x with ⟨proposed, hFull, hHeldIn⟩
        by_cases hx : x = proposer
        · subst x
          refine ⟨proposed ++ [w0], ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hFull, hRem, hNextRem]
            simp [List.append_assoc]
          · intro y hHeldNext
            by_cases hy : y = w0
            · subst y
              simp
            · have hHeldBefore : s.matching.held y = some proposer := by
                simpa [hOtherHeld y hy] using hHeldNext
              exact False.elim (hFree y hHeldBefore)
        · refine ⟨proposed, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hFull, hOtherRem x hx]
          · intro y hHeldNext
            by_cases hy : y = w0
            · subst y
              rcases hChange with hWasEmpty | hWasHeld
              · rcases hWasEmpty with ⟨_, hNow⟩
                have hEq : x = proposer := by
                  exact (Option.some.inj (hNow.symm.trans hHeldNext)).symm
                exact False.elim (hx hEq)
              · rcases hWasHeld with ⟨old, hOld, hNow⟩
                have hChosenEq :
                    chooseBetterForW prefW w0 proposer old = x := by
                  exact Option.some.inj (hNow.symm.trans hHeldNext)
                have hChoice :
                    chooseBetterForW prefW w0 proposer old = proposer ∨
                      chooseBetterForW prefW w0 proposer old = old := by
                  unfold chooseBetterForW
                  by_cases hp : prefW.pref w0 proposer old
                  · simp [hp]
                  · simp [hp]
                rcases hChoice with hChosenProposer | hChosenOld
                · have hEq : x = proposer := by
                    exact (hChosenProposer.symm.trans hChosenEq).symm
                  exact False.elim (hx hEq)
                · have hOldEq : old = x := hChosenOld.symm.trans hChosenEq
                  have hHeldBefore : s.matching.held w0 = some x := by
                    simpa [hOldEq] using hOld
                  exact hHeldIn w0 hHeldBefore
            · have hHeldBefore : s.matching.held y = some x := by
                simpa [hOtherHeld y hy] using hHeldNext
              exact hHeldIn y hHeldBefore
  have run_preserves :
      ∀ {s f : ProposalState Man Woman} {sched : List Man},
        ProposalRun prefW s sched f →
          (∀ x : Man, ∃ proposed : List Woman,
            fullList x = proposed ++ s.rem x ∧
              ∀ y : Woman, s.matching.held y = some x → y ∈ proposed) →
            ∀ x : Man, ∃ proposed : List Woman,
              fullList x = proposed ++ f.rem x ∧
                ∀ y : Woman, f.matching.held y = some x → y ∈ proposed := by
    intro s f sched hRun
    induction hRun with
    | nil state =>
        intro hInv
        exact hInv
    | cons hStep hTail ih =>
        intro hInv
        exact ih (step_preserves hStep hInv)
  have hHeldPrefix :
      ∀ x : Man, ∃ proposed : List Woman,
        fullList x = proposed ++ state.rem x ∧
          ∀ y : Woman, state.matching.held y = some x → y ∈ proposed := by
    apply run_preserves hReach
    intro x
    refine ⟨[], ?_, ?_⟩
    · rfl
    · intro y hHeld
      simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at hHeld
  intro hMem
  by_cases hFree : freeMan state.matching m
  · have hRemEmpty : state.rem m = [] := hQuiet m hFree
    rw [hRemEmpty] at hMem
    simpa using hMem
  · have hExists : ∃ current : Woman, state.matching.held current = some m := by
      by_contra hNoHeld
      exact hFree (by
        intro current hHeld
        exact hNoHeld ⟨current, hHeld⟩)
    have hPartner :
        partnerOfMan state.matching m = some (Classical.choose hExists) := by
      unfold partnerOfMan
      simp [hExists]
    have hPrefCurrent : prefM.pref m w (Classical.choose hExists) := by
      unfold ManPrefersCurrent at hPref
      rw [hPartner] at hPref
      exact hPref
    rcases hHeldPrefix m with ⟨proposed, hFull, hHeldIn⟩
    have hCurrentIn : Classical.choose hExists ∈ proposed :=
      hHeldIn (Classical.choose hExists) (Classical.choose_spec hExists)
    have hOrdered : (fullList m).Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂) :=
      (hSound m).2
    rw [hFull] at hOrdered
    have hCross :
        ∀ x ∈ proposed, ∀ y ∈ state.rem m, prefM.pref m x y := by
      exact (List.pairwise_append.mp hOrdered).2.2
    have hCurrentPrefW : prefM.pref m (Classical.choose hExists) w :=
      hCross (Classical.choose hExists) hCurrentIn w hMem
    exact prefM.irrefl m w (prefM.trans m hPrefCurrent hCurrentPrefW)

theorem removed_from_rem_has_proposal_step
    {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :
    ∀ {initial final : ProposalState Man Woman} {schedule : List Man}
      {m : Man} {w : Woman},
      ProposalRun prefW initial schedule final →
        (initial.rem m).Nodup →
          w ∈ initial.rem m →
            w ∉ final.rem m →
              ∃ pre later stateBefore stateAfter tail,
                schedule = pre ++ m :: later ∧
                  ProposalRun prefW initial pre stateBefore ∧
                    ProposalRun prefW stateAfter later final ∧
                      FreeManIn stateBefore.matching m ∧
                        stateBefore.rem m = w :: tail ∧
                          ((stateBefore.matching.held w = none ∧
                              stateAfter.matching.held w = some m) ∨
                            ∃ old,
                              stateBefore.matching.held w = some old ∧
                                stateAfter.matching.held w =
                                  some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) := by
  intro initial final schedule m w hRun
  induction hRun with
  | nil state =>
      intro hNodup hMem hNotMem
      exact False.elim (hNotMem hMem)
  | @cons state mid final proposer sched hStep hTail ih =>
      intro hNodup hMem hNotMem
      rcases hStep with hInactive | hActive
      · rcases hInactive with ⟨hNotFree, hMid⟩
        subst mid
        rcases ih hNodup hMem hNotMem with
          ⟨pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail, hSched, hPre, hLater, hFree, hRem, hChange⟩
        refine ⟨proposer :: pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail, ?_, ?_, hLater,
          hFree, hRem, hChange⟩
        · simp [hSched]
        · exact ProposalRun.cons (Or.inl ⟨hNotFree, rfl⟩) hPre
      · rcases hActive with hEmpty | hProposal
        · rcases hEmpty with ⟨hFreeEmpty, hRemEmpty, hMid⟩
          subst mid
          rcases ih hNodup hMem hNotMem with
            ⟨pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail, hSched, hPre, hLater, hFree, hRem, hChange⟩
          refine ⟨proposer :: pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail, ?_, ?_, hLater,
            hFree, hRem, hChange⟩
          · simp [hSched]
          · exact ProposalRun.cons (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hFreeEmpty, hRemEmpty, rfl⟩)) hPre
        · rcases hProposal with
            ⟨target, tail, hFree, hRem, hChange, hOtherHeld, hNextRem, hOtherRem⟩
          by_cases hp : proposer = m
          · subst proposer
            have hStateRem : state.rem m = target :: tail := hRem
            by_cases hwt : w = target
            · subst target
              refine ⟨[], sched, state, mid, tail, ?_, ?_, hTail, hFree, hRem, hChange⟩
              · simp
              · exact ProposalRun.nil state
            · have hMemTail : w ∈ tail := by
                rw [hStateRem] at hMem
                simpa [hwt] using hMem
              have hTailNodup : tail.Nodup := by
                rw [hStateRem] at hNodup
                exact hNodup.of_cons
              have hNotFinal : w ∉ final.rem m := hNotMem
              have hMidMem : w ∈ mid.rem m := by
                simpa [hNextRem] using hMemTail
              have hMidNodup : (mid.rem m).Nodup := by
                simpa [hNextRem] using hTailNodup
              rcases ih hMidNodup hMidMem hNotFinal with
                ⟨pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail2, hSched, hPre, hLater,
                  hFree2, hRem2, hChange2⟩
              refine ⟨m :: pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail2, ?_, ?_, hLater,
                hFree2, hRem2, hChange2⟩
              · simp [hSched]
              · exact ProposalRun.cons (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨target, tail, hFree, hRem, hChange,
                  hOtherHeld, hNextRem, hOtherRem⟩)) hPre
          · have hmp : m ≠ proposer := fun h => hp h.symm
            have hMidMem : w ∈ mid.rem m := by
              simpa [hOtherRem m hmp] using hMem
            have hMidNodup : (mid.rem m).Nodup := by
              simpa [hOtherRem m hmp] using hNodup
            rcases ih hMidNodup hMidMem hNotMem with
              ⟨pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail2, hSched, hPre, hLater,
                hFree2, hRem2, hChange2⟩
            refine ⟨proposer :: pre, later, stateBefore, stateAfter, tail2, ?_, ?_, hLater,
              hFree2, hRem2, hChange2⟩
            · simp [hSched]
            · exact ProposalRun.cons (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨target, tail, hFree, hRem, hChange,
                hOtherHeld, hNextRem, hOtherRem⟩)) hPre

theorem held_self_later_not_self_gives_better_holder
    {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :
    ∀ {state final : ProposalState Man Woman} {schedule : List Man}
      {w : Woman} {m : Man},
      ProposalRun prefW state schedule final →
        state.matching.held w = some m →
          final.matching.held w ≠ some m →
            ∃ held : Man, final.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m := by
  intro state final schedule w m hRun
  induction hRun with
  | nil state =>
      intro hHeld hNot
      exact False.elim (hNot hHeld)
  | @cons state mid final activated sched hStep hTail ih =>
      intro hHeld hNot
      rcases hStep with hInactive | hActive
      · rcases hInactive with ⟨_, hMid⟩
        subst mid
        exact ih hHeld hNot
      · rcases hActive with hEmpty | hProposal

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧

                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

inductive ProposalRun (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) :

      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →
          ProposalRun prefW state (m :: schedule) final

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

def QuiescentState (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : Man, FreeManIn state.matching m → state.rem m = []

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrentNoDecidable
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :

  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPairNoDecidable

    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrentNoDecidable prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=

  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by

    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)

  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if _hfree : freeMan state.matching m then

  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

                                             

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

                                                                                   

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧

              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧

                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=

  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

    rcases hMemFull with hLeft | hRight
    · exact hLeft
    · exact False.elim (hNotRem hRight)
  rcases hResp w hMemProposed with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
  rw [hHeld] at hWoman
  rcases hWeak with hEq | hHeldPref
  · subst held
    exact prefW.irrefl w m hWoman
  · exact prefW.irrefl w m (prefW.trans w hWoman hHeldPref)

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

namespace GaleShapleyStableMatchingFormalizeProbe

universe u v

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)
  irrefl : ∀ agent x, ¬ pref agent x x
  trans : ∀ agent {x y z}, pref agent x y → pref agent y z → pref agent x z
  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)
    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

instance instDecidableFreeMan [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man]
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

noncomputable def partnerOfMan (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Option Woman :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)
        { matching := { held := updateHeld state.matching.held w nextHeld }
          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

private theorem pairwise_rel_of_mem_left_mem_right {α : Type*} {R : α → α → Prop}
    {left right : List α} (h : (left ++ right).Pairwise R)
    {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ left) (hb : b ∈ right) : R a b := by
  induction left with
  | nil =>
      simp at ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.cons_append] at h
      cases h with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          simp only [List.mem_cons] at ha
          rcases ha with rfl | ha
          · exact hhead b (by simp [hb])
          · exact ih htail ha

private theorem weaklyPrefers_trans
    (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt) {agent : Agent} {a b c : Alt}
    (hab : WeaklyPrefers prefs agent b a)
    (hbc : WeaklyPrefers prefs agent c b) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefs agent c a := by
  rcases hbc with rfl | hcb
  · exact hab
  · rcases hab with rfl | hba
    · exact Or.inr hcb
    · exact Or.inr (prefs.trans agent hcb hba)

private theorem chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) old := by
  unfold WeaklyPrefers chooseBetterForW
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
    prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

private theorem chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_incoming
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man) :
    WeaklyPrefers prefW w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) incoming := by
  unfold chooseBetterForW
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
    prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
  by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
  · simp [h, WeaklyPrefers]
  · by_cases heq : old = incoming
    · simp [h, heq, WeaklyPrefers]
    · have htotal := prefW.total w (Ne.symm heq)
      rcases htotal with hio | hoi
      · exact False.elim (h hio)
      · simp [h, WeaklyPrefers, hoi]

private theorem proposalStep_rem_suffix
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (fullList : Man → List Woman)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m) :
    ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m := by
  intro m
  unfold proposalStep
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree]
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp
        exact hSuffix m
    | cons w tail =>
        simp
        by_cases hm : m = proposer
        · subst m
          obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix proposer
          refine ⟨prefList ++ [w], ?_⟩
          rw [hprefList, hrem]
          simp
        · obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix m
          refine ⟨prefList, ?_⟩
          simpa [Function.update, hm] using hprefList
  · simp [hfree]
    exact hSuffix m

private theorem proposalStep_held_removed
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m)
    (hRemoved : ∀ m w, state.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ state.rem m) :
    ∀ m w, (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held w = some m →
      w ∉ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m := by
  intro m w hheld hmem
  unfold proposalStep at hheld hmem
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree] at hheld hmem
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp [hrem] at hheld hmem
        exact hRemoved m w hheld hmem
    | cons proposed tail =>
        simp [hrem] at hheld hmem
        by_cases hw : w = proposed
        · subst w
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffix proposer
            have hNodupFull : (fullList proposer).Nodup := (hSound proposer).1
            have hNodupRem : (proposed :: tail).Nodup := by
              rw [hprefList, hrem] at hNodupFull
              exact hNodupFull.of_append_right
            have hnotTail : proposed ∉ tail := by
              have hNodupCons : proposed ∉ tail ∧ tail.Nodup := by
                simpa using hNodupRem
              exact hNodupCons.1
            have hmemTail : proposed ∈ tail := by
              simpa [Function.update] using hmem
            exact hnotTail hmemTail
          · have hOldHeld : state.matching.held proposed = some m := by
              cases hstateHeld : state.matching.held proposed with
              | none =>
                  have hmprop : m = proposer := by
                    have hsome : some m = some proposer := by
                      simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld] using hheld.symm
                    exact Option.some.inj hsome
                  exact (hm hmprop).elim
              | some old =>
                  by_cases hbetter : prefW.pref proposed proposer old
                  · have hmprop : m = proposer := by
                      have hsome : some m = some proposer := by
                        simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hbetter] using hheld.symm
                      exact Option.some.inj hsome
                    exact (hm hmprop).elim
                  · have holdm : old = m := by
                      have hsome : some old = some m := by
                        simpa [updateHeld, hstateHeld, chooseBetterForW, hbetter] using hheld
                      exact Option.some.inj hsome
                    simp [holdm]
            have hmemOld : proposed ∈ state.rem m := by
              by_cases hm' : m = proposer
              · exact (hm hm').elim
              · simpa [Function.update, hm'] using hmem
            exact hRemoved m proposed hOldHeld hmemOld
        · have hOldHeld : state.matching.held w = some m := by
            unfold updateHeld at hheld
            simpa [hw] using hheld
          by_cases hm : m = proposer
          · subst m
            exact hfree w hOldHeld
          · have hmemOld : w ∈ state.rem m := by
              simpa [Function.update, hm] using hmem
            exact hRemoved m w hOldHeld hmemOld
  · simp [hfree] at hheld hmem
    exact hRemoved m w hheld hmem

private theorem postProposals_invariants
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList) :
    (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m =
      prefList ++ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m) ∧
    (∀ m w,
      (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).matching.held w = some m →
        w ∉ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m) := by
  have hGeneral :
      ∀ (start : ProposalState Man Woman) (sched : List Man),
        (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ start.rem m) →
        (∀ m w, start.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ start.rem m) →
        (∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m =
          prefList ++ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m) ∧
        (∀ m w, (postProposals prefW start sched).matching.held w = some m →
          w ∉ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m) := by
    intro start sched
    induction sched generalizing start with
    | nil =>
        intro hSuffix hRemoved
        simp [postProposals]
        exact ⟨hSuffix, hRemoved⟩
    | cons proposer rest ih =>
        intro hSuffix hRemoved
        simp [postProposals]
        let mid := proposalStep prefW start proposer
        have hMidSuffix : ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ mid.rem m := by
          exact proposalStep_rem_suffix prefW fullList start proposer hSuffix
        have hMidRemoved : ∀ m w, mid.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ mid.rem m := by
          exact proposalStep_held_removed prefM prefW fullList start proposer
            hSound hSuffix hRemoved
        simpa [mid, postProposals] using ih mid hMidSuffix hMidRemoved
  have hInitSuffix :
      ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ (openingState fullList).rem m := by
    intro m
    exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  have hInitRemoved :
      ∀ m w, (openingState fullList).matching.held w = some m →
        w ∉ (openingState fullList).rem m := by
    intro m w hheld
    simp [openingState, emptyMatching] at hheld
  exact hGeneral (openingState fullList) schedule hInitSuffix hInitRemoved

private theorem preferred_candidate_removed_from_remainder
    [Fintype Man] [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) {state : ProposalState Man Woman}
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hRun : ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state)
    (hQuiet : Quiescent state)
    (hComplete : ∀ m w, w ∈ fullList m) :
    ∀ m w, ManPrefersCurrent prefM state.matching m w → w ∉ state.rem m := by
  intro m w hPref hmem
  have hInv := postProposals_invariants prefM prefW fullList schedule hSound
  have hRunEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by
    simpa [ProposalRun] using hRun
  have hSuffixState :
      ∀ m, ∃ prefList, fullList m = prefList ++ state.rem m := by
    simpa [hRunEq] using hInv.1
  have hRemovedState :
      ∀ m w, state.matching.held w = some m → w ∉ state.rem m := by
    simpa [hRunEq] using hInv.2
  unfold ManPrefersCurrent at hPref
  unfold partnerOfMan at hPref
  by_cases hexists : ∃ wCurrent : Woman, state.matching.held wCurrent = some m
  · simp [hexists] at hPref
    let wCurrent : Woman := Classical.choose hexists
    have hHeldCurrent : state.matching.held wCurrent = some m :=
      Classical.choose_spec hexists
    have hCurrentNotMem : wCurrent ∉ state.rem m :=
      hRemovedState m wCurrent hHeldCurrent
    obtain ⟨prefList, hprefList⟩ := hSuffixState m
    have hCurrentMemFull : wCurrent ∈ fullList m := hComplete m wCurrent
    have hCurrentMemPrefix : wCurrent ∈ prefList := by
      rw [hprefList, List.mem_append] at hCurrentMemFull
      rcases hCurrentMemFull with hcur | hcur
      · exact hcur
      · exact (hCurrentNotMem hcur).elim
    have hOrdered : ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m) := (hSound m).2
    have hCurrentPrefersW : prefM.pref m wCurrent w := by
      rw [hprefList] at hOrdered
      exact pairwise_rel_of_mem_left_mem_right hOrdered hCurrentMemPrefix hmem
    have hPrefers : prefM.pref m w wCurrent := by
      simpa [wCurrent] using hPref
    exact (prefM.irrefl m w) (prefM.trans m hPrefers hCurrentPrefersW)
  · have hfree : freeMan state.matching m := by
      intro w0 hheld
      exact hexists ⟨w0, hheld⟩
    have hremEmpty : state.rem m = [] := hQuiet m hfree
    simp [hremEmpty] at hmem

private theorem proposalStep_response_invariant
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (fullList : Man → List Woman)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (proposer : Man)
    (hInv : ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m = proposed ++ state.rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held, state.matching.held w = some held ∧ WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m) :
    ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m = proposed ++ (proposalStep prefW state proposer).rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held, (proposalStep prefW state proposer).matching.held w = some held ∧
            WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
  intro m
  unfold proposalStep
  by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching proposer
  · simp [hfree]
    cases hrem : state.rem proposer with
    | nil =>
        simp
        exact hInv m
    | cons proposedWoman tail =>
        simp
        by_cases hm : m = proposer
        · subst m
          rcases hInv proposer with ⟨already, hFull, hResp⟩
          refine ⟨already ++ [proposedWoman], ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hFull, hrem]
            simp
          · intro w hw
            have hwCases := List.mem_append.mp hw
            rcases hwCases with hwAlready | hwLast
            · rcases hResp w hwAlready with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
              by_cases hwEq : w = proposedWoman
              · subst w
                cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
                | none =>
                    exact False.elim (by simpa [hOld] using hHeld)
                | some old =>
                    have hheldEq : held = old := by
                      exact Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hOld)
                    subst held
                    refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                    · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                    · exact weaklyPrefers_trans prefW hWeak
                        (chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old prefW proposedWoman proposer old)
              · refine ⟨held, ?_, hWeak⟩
                simp [updateHeld, hwEq]
                exact hHeld
            · have hwEq : w = proposedWoman := by
                simpa using hwLast
              subst w
              cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
              | none =>
                  refine ⟨proposer, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
                  simp [updateHeld, hOld]
              | some old =>
                  refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                  · exact chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_incoming prefW proposedWoman proposer old
        · rcases hInv m with ⟨already, hFull, hResp⟩
          refine ⟨already, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [Function.update, hm] using hFull
          · intro w hw
            rcases hResp w hw with ⟨held, hHeld, hWeak⟩
            by_cases hwEq : w = proposedWoman
            · subst w
              cases hOld : state.matching.held proposedWoman with
              | none =>
                  exact False.elim (by simpa [hOld] using hHeld)
              | some old =>
                  have hheldEq : held = old := by
                    exact Option.some.inj (hHeld.symm.trans hOld)
                  subst held
                  refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW proposedWoman proposer old, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · simp [updateHeld, hOld]
                  · exact weaklyPrefers_trans prefW hWeak
                      (chooseBetterForW_weakly_prefers_old prefW proposedWoman proposer old)
            · refine ⟨held, ?_, hWeak⟩
              simp [updateHeld, hwEq]
              exact hHeld
  · simp [hfree]
    exact hInv m

private theorem postProposals_response_invariant
    [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) :
    ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
      fullList m =
        proposed ++ (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).rem m ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
          ∃ held,
            (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).matching.held w =
                some held ∧
              WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
  have hGeneral :
      ∀ (start : ProposalState Man Woman) (sched : List Man),
        (∀ m, ∃ proposed, fullList m = proposed ++ start.rem m ∧
          ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
            ∃ held, start.matching.held w = some held ∧
              WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m) →
        ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
          fullList m = proposed ++ (postProposals prefW start sched).rem m ∧
            ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
              ∃ held, (postProposals prefW start sched).matching.held w = some held ∧
                WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
    intro start sched
    induction sched generalizing start with
    | nil =>
        intro hInv
        simpa [postProposals] using hInv
    | cons proposer rest ih =>
        intro hInv
        simp [postProposals]
        let mid := proposalStep prefW start proposer
        have hMid :
            ∀ m, ∃ proposed, fullList m = proposed ++ mid.rem m ∧
              ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
                ∃ held, mid.matching.held w = some held ∧
                  WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
          exact proposalStep_response_invariant prefW fullList start proposer hInv
        simpa [mid, postProposals] using ih mid hMid
  have hInit :
      ∀ m, ∃ proposed,
        fullList m = proposed ++ (openingState fullList).rem m ∧
          ∀ w, w ∈ proposed →
            ∃ held, (openingState fullList).matching.held w = some held ∧
              WeaklyPrefers prefW w held m := by
    intro m
    refine ⟨[], rfl, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    simp at hw
  exact hGeneral (openingState fullList) schedule hInit

theorem quiescent_reachable_state_stable_of_complete_preferences : ∀ {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}
      [Fintype Man] [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
      (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
      (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man)
      (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
      ProposalListsSound prefM fullList →

abbrev Grid := List (List Nat)
abbrev Cell := Nat × Nat

def cellAt (g : Grid) (y x : Nat) : Nat := (g.getD y []).getD x 0

def gridMap (g : Grid) (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat) : Grid :=
  (List.range g.length).map fun y =>
    (List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).map fun x => f y x (cellAt g y x)

def recolorMap (g : Grid) (m : List (Nat × Nat)) : Grid :=
  gridMap g fun _ _ c => ((m.find? (fun p => p.1 == c)).map Prod.snd).getD c

def consumeRowExtremal (g : Grid) (color repl : Nat) (useMin : Bool) : Grid :=
  g.map fun row =>
    let idxs := (List.range row.length).filter (fun x => row.getD x 0 == color)
    match (if useMin then idxs.head? else idxs.getLast?) with
    | none => row
    | some k => (List.range row.length).map fun x => if x = k then repl else row.getD x 0

def countColor (g : Grid) (c : Nat) : Nat :=
  (g.map (fun row => (row.filter (fun v => v == c)).length)).foldl (· + ·) 0

  | 0 => g
  | Nat.succ k => consumeRowExtremalK (consumeRowExtremal g color repl useMin) color repl useMin k

def adj (a b : Cell) : Bool :=
  ((a.1 == b.1) && (a.2 + 1 == b.2 || b.2 + 1 == a.2)) ||
  ((a.2 == b.2) && (a.1 + 1 == b.1 || b.1 + 1 == a.1))

def growOnce (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell × List Cell :=
  let added := rest.filter (fun c => comp.any (fun k => adj k c))
  (comp ++ added, rest.filter (fun c => ! comp.any (fun k => adj k c)))

def component (seed : Cell) (cells : List Cell) (fuel : Nat) : List Cell :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => [seed]
  | Nat.succ f =>
    let rec go (n : Nat) (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell :=
      match n with
      | 0 => comp
      | Nat.succ m =>
        let (c2, r2) := growOnce comp rest
        if c2.length = comp.length then comp else go m c2 r2
    go (Nat.succ f) [seed] (cells.filter (fun c => c ≠ seed))

def matchCells (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) : List Cell :=
  ((List.range g.length).map fun y =>
    ((List.range ((g.getD y []).length)).filter
      (fun x => colors.contains (cellAt g y x))).map (fun x => (y, x))).flatten

def componentsOf (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) : List (List Cell) :=
  let cells := matchCells g colors
  let rec go (n : Nat) (remaining : List Cell) (acc : List (List Cell)) : List (List Cell) :=
    match n, remaining with
    | 0, _ => acc
    | _, [] => acc
    | Nat.succ m, seed :: _ =>
      let comp := component seed remaining remaining.length
      go m (remaining.filter (fun c => ! comp.contains c)) (acc ++ [comp])
  go cells.length cells []

  comp.all (fun c =>
    let ny := (c.1 : Int) + dy
    let nx := (c.2 : Int) + dx

    decide (0 ≤ nx) && decide (nx < ((g.getD 0 []).length : Int)) &&
    (comp.contains (ny.toNat, nx.toNat) || destOk.contains (cellAt g ny.toNat nx.toNat)))
